**Deciding Monopoly Strategy**

I've just snapped up Electric Company. Now, I'm stuck in the "AWAITING_DECISION" phase. The end of my turn is staring me in the face, but I'm pondering how to maximize my advantage. What's the optimal play here? Do I force the issue, or wait? My inner bully is getting impatient. Time to decide!


**Evaluating The Options**

The analysis confirms my initial suspicion; I have the upper hand, for now. No trades make sense yet. Mortgaging is out of the question. I should maintain my superior position by ending the turn, and letting the others stew in their Light Blue feud. I will mock them.


**Assessing The Weakness**

Now I see it. I'm going to let these two argue over their stupid streets. Mortgaging is still out of the question and there is no trade I want to make yet. My advantage is in watching them overextend. I will end the turn and then savor the chaos.
